refreshNotes:
MY2025 iX continues the original launch lineup with xDrive50 and M60 trims. The xDrive45 was not yet available in MY2025. xDrive50 EPA range up to 309 mi; M60 up to 280 mi. Battery 105 kWh usable on xDrive50, 106.3 kWh on M60. MSRPs roughly $87,250 (xDrive50) and $111,500 (M60), plus $1,175 destination.

Sources:
- https://www.jdpower.com/cars/2026/bmw/ix (historical comparison)
- https://www.kbb.com/bmw/ix/
